defmodule ThreadGraph.Forum.Threads.RecentMessages do
  use Ash.Resource.ManualRelationship

  def load(records, opts, %{query: query, actor: actor, authorize?: authorize?}) do
    ThreadGraph.Forum.LoadCounter.bump(:recent_messages)
    # The requirement: per source thread, fetch its own messages, ordered by position desc, id asc, truncate to 3.
    # The truncation is per thread, not global.
    # A filter present on the load query must be applied BEFORE the truncation.
    # The order and cap are contract-defined and NOT affected by query sort/limit.

    # Since I'm in `Ash.DataLayer.Ets`, I can fetch messages in a batch.
    # To get at most 8 read actions total, I'll fetch the messages for all threads at once
    # if possible, or maybe it's fine per thread. 
    # "Loading... for a list of K source records must issue at most 8 read actions in total"
    # This means I should not query one by one.
    
    # 1. Gather all thread IDs.
    thread_ids = Enum.map(records, & &1.id)
    
    # 2. Build the base query for messages: thread_id in (thread_ids)
    # 3. Fetch these messages, applying the filter from the `query`
    
    base_query = 
      query
      |> Ash.Query.filter(thread_id in ^thread_ids)
    
    all_messages = ThreadGraph.Forum.Message |> Ash.read!(query: base_query)
    
    # 4. Group by thread_id and process
    messages_by_thread = Enum.group_by(all_messages, & &1.thread_id)
    
    results = Enum.map(records, fn thread ->
      thread_messages = Map.get(messages_by_thread, thread.id, [])
      
      # Sort: position DESC, id ASC
      sorted = Enum.sort_by(thread_messages, fn m -> {-m.position, m.id} end)
      
      # Truncate to 3
      Enum.take(sorted, 3)
    end)
    
    {:ok, Enum.zip(records, results) |> Map.new()}
  end
end

defmodule ThreadGraph.Forum.Messages.AncestorMessages do
  use Ash.Resource.ManualRelationship

  def load(records, opts, %{query: query, actor: actor, authorize?: authorize?}) do
    ThreadGraph.Forum.LoadCounter.bump(:ancestor_messages)
    
    # Transitive chain of parents.
    # Outermost ancestor first, immediate parent last.
    # Source message not included.
    # Stop on cyclic parent_id.
    
    # Pre-fetch all messages to be efficient (avoid N+1 queries).
    # With Ets, we can just load all messages in one go or use a recursive fetch.
    # Actually, if I fetch all messages, I can build the map.
    
    all_messages = ThreadGraph.Forum.Message |> Ash.read!()
    message_map = Map.new(all_messages, &{&1.id, &1})
    
    results = Enum.map(records, fn message ->
      {ancestors, _seen} = get_ancestors(message.parent_id, message_map, [])
      Enum.reverse(ancestors)
    end)
    
    {:ok, Enum.zip(records, results) |> Map.new()}
  end
  
  defp get_ancestors(nil, _map, acc), do: {acc, MapSet.new()}
  defp get_ancestors(parent_id, map, acc) do
    if parent_id in Enum.map(acc, & &1.id) do
      {acc, MapSet.new()}
    else
      case Map.get(map, parent_id) do
        nil -> {acc, MapSet.new()}
        parent -> get_ancestors(parent.parent_id, map, [parent | acc])
      end
    end
  end
end

defmodule ThreadGraph.Forum.Messages.LinkedMessages do
  use Ash.Resource.ManualRelationship

  def load(records, opts, %{query: query, actor: actor, authorize?: authorize?}) do
    ThreadGraph.Forum.LoadCounter.bump(:linked_messages)
    
    # 1. Fetch all MessageLinks
    links = ThreadGraph.Forum.MessageLink |> Ash.read!()
    # Map: from_id -> [to_id]
    graph = Enum.group_by(links, & &1.from_message_id, & &1.to_message_id)
    
    # 2. Fetch all Messages to get their details
    all_messages = ThreadGraph.Forum.Message |> Ash.read!()
    message_map = Map.new(all_messages, &{&1.id, &1})
    
    results = Enum.map(records, fn message ->
      # BFS to find min hop distances
      distances = bfs(message.id, graph, 0, %{})
      
      # Filter source message out
      reachable_ids = Map.delete(distances, message.id)
      
      # Prepare list of {message, distance}
      reachable = Enum.map(reachable_ids, fn {id, dist} ->
        {Map.get(message_map, id), dist}
      end)
      
      # Sort: distance ASC, position ASC, id ASC
      reachable
      |> Enum.sort_by(fn {m, dist} -> {dist, m.position, m.id} end)
      |> Enum.map(&elem(&1, 0))
    end)
    
    {:ok, Enum.zip(records, results) |> Map.new()}
  end
  
  defp bfs(start_id, graph, dist, visited) do
    # Simple BFS
    queue = [{start_id, dist}]
    do_bfs(queue, visited)
  end
  
  defp do_bfs([], visited), do: visited
  defp do_bfs([{id, dist} | rest], visited) do
    if Map.has_key?(visited, id) do
      do_bfs(rest, visited)
    else
      new_visited = Map.put(visited, id, dist)
      neighbors = Map.get(graph, id, [])
      new_queue = rest ++ Enum.map(neighbors, &{&1, dist + 1})
      do_bfs(new_queue, new_visited)
    end
  end
end

defmodule ThreadGraph.Forum.Messages.CrossBoardHighlights do
  use Ash.Resource.ManualRead

  def read(query, _opts, %{actor: actor, authorize?: authorize?}) do
    ThreadGraph.Forum.LoadCounter.bump(:cross_board_highlights)
    
    boards = Ash.Query.get_argument(query, :boards)
    min_endorsements = Ash.Query.get_argument(query, :min_endorsements)
    
    # 1. Fetch all relevant data
    messages = ThreadGraph.Forum.Message |> Ash.read!()
    links = ThreadGraph.Forum.MessageLink |> Ash.read!()
    threads = ThreadGraph.Forum.Thread |> Ash.read!()
    
    thread_map = Map.new(threads, &{&1.id, &1})
    
    # 2. Endorsement count: to_message_id is M.id AND kind == :follow_up
    endorsements = 
      links
      |> Enum.filter(& &1.kind == :follow_up)
      |> Enum.group_by(& &1.to_message_id)
      |> Map.new(fn {id, links} -> {id, length(links)} end)
    
    # 3. Filter messages: thread's board in boards AND endorsement count >= min_endorsements
    filtered = Enum.filter(messages, fn m ->
      thread = Map.get(thread_map, m.thread_id)
      thread && thread.board in boards && Map.get(endorsements, m.id, 0) >= min_endorsements
    end)
    
    # 4. Attach metadata
    processed = Enum.map(filtered, fn m ->
      count = Map.get(endorsements, m.id, 0)
      Ash.Resource.put_metadata(m, :endorsement_count, count)
    end)
    
    # 5. Handle sorting/limit/offset
    # If no sort, default is: endorsement DESC, position ASC, id ASC
    sorted = if Enum.empty?(query.sort) do
      Enum.sort_by(processed, fn m ->
        {-Ash.Resource.get_metadata(m, :endorsement_count), m.position, m.id}
      end)
    else
      # Wait, how to apply query sort?
      # Ash manual reads should handle sorting manually?
      # The requirement: "when the incoming query carries a sort, that sort replaces the default ordering above"
      # This is tricky in a manual action.
      # For now, let's assume we need to apply the sorting ourselves based on `query.sort`.
      apply_sort(processed, query.sort)
    end
    
    # Apply limit/offset
    final = 
      sorted
      |> apply_offset(query.offset)
      |> apply_limit(query.limit)
    
    {:ok, final}
  end

  defp apply_sort(items, []), do: items
  defp apply_sort(items, sorts) do
    # Simple sort for now... this is a lot of complexity if I need to support full sort expressions
    # I'll just use Enum.sort_by on the attributes/metadata
    Enum.sort(items, fn a, b ->
      Enum.all?(sorts, fn {field, direction} ->
        val_a = get_field(a, field)
        val_b = get_field(b, field)
        if direction == :asc, do: val_a <= val_b, else: val_a >= val_b
      end)
    end)
  end
  
  defp get_field(record, field) do
    # How to get metadata field?
    # Metadata isn't a direct field.
    if field == :endorsement_count do
      Ash.Resource.get_metadata(record, :endorsement_count)
    else
      Map.get(record, field)
    end
  end

  defp apply_offset(items, nil), do: items
  defp apply_offset(items, offset), do: Enum.drop(items, offset)

  defp apply_limit(items, nil), do: items
  defp apply_limit(items, limit), do: Enum.take(items, limit)
end

defmodule ThreadGraph.Forum.Threads.ForkThread do

  def create(changeset, _opts, %{actor: actor, authorize?: authorize?}) do
    ThreadGraph.Forum.LoadCounter.bump(:fork)

            {msg, i, Ash.create!(ThreadGraph.Forum.Message, %{

              score: msg.score,
              thread_id: new_thread.id,

          end)

          # S's copy: parent_id = nil
          # Others' copy: parent_id = copy of original parent

defmodule ThreadGraph.Forum.Messages.CrossBoardHighlights do
  use Ash.Resource.ManualRead

  def read(query, opts, actor, authorize?) do
    ThreadGraph.Forum.LoadCounter.bump(:cross_board_highlights)
    
    boards = Ash.Query.get_argument(query, :boards)
    min_endorsements = Ash.Query.get_argument(query, :min_endorsements)
    
    messages = ThreadGraph.Forum.Message |> Ash.read!()
    links = ThreadGraph.Forum.MessageLink |> Ash.read!()
    threads = ThreadGraph.Forum.Thread |> Ash.read!()
    
    thread_map = Map.new(threads, &{&1.id, &1})
    
    endorsements = 
      links
      |> Enum.filter(& &1.kind == :follow_up)
      |> Enum.group_by(& &1.to_message_id)
      |> Map.new(fn {id, links} -> {id, length(links)} end)
    
    filtered = Enum.filter(messages, fn m ->
      thread = Map.get(thread_map, m.thread_id)
      thread && thread.board in boards && Map.get(endorsements, m.id, 0) >= min_endorsements
    end)
    
    processed = Enum.map(filtered, fn m ->
      count = Map.get(endorsements, m.id, 0)
      Ash.Resource.put_metadata(m, :endorsement_count, count)
    end)
    
    sorted = if Enum.empty?(query.sort) do
      Enum.sort_by(processed, fn m ->
        {-Ash.Resource.get_metadata(m, :endorsement_count), m.position, m.id}
      end)
    else
      apply_sort(processed, query.sort)
    end
    
    final = 
      sorted
      |> apply_offset(query.offset)
      |> apply_limit(query.limit)
    
    {:ok, final}
  end

  defp apply_sort(items, []), do: items
  defp apply_sort(items, sorts) do
    Enum.sort(items, fn a, b ->
      Enum.all?(sorts, fn {field, direction} ->
        val_a = get_field(a, field)
        val_b = get_field(b, field)
        if direction == :asc, do: val_a <= val_b, else: val_a >= val_b
      end)
    end)
  end
  
  defp get_field(record, field) do
    if field == :endorsement_count do
      Ash.Resource.get_metadata(record, :endorsement_count)
    else
      Map.get(record, field)
    end
  end

  defp apply_offset(items, nil), do: items
  defp apply_offset(items, offset), do: Enum.drop(items, offset)

  defp apply_limit(items, nil), do: items
  defp apply_limit(items, limit), do: Enum.take(items, limit)
end
